summary: Nebius is dutch company developing a portfolio of AI-related technology assets, founded in 2004. Type: listed company. About 1,371 employees (Wikidata). Revenue $118 million (2024). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 98% of its 44 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 3 about funding; 5 about acquisitions; 11 about growth or hiring; 1 about legal trouble, strikes or bankruptcy.

culture.text: A mid-sized company of about 1,371 employees in 2025.
Runs an AI cloud platform launched in November 2023, as an NVIDIA preferred cloud provider.
Hosted a Build Week hackathon in partnership with NVIDIA.

open.text: Nebius B.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.

growth.text: Had US$117.5 million revenue and a US$641.4 million net loss in 2024.
Q2 revenue rose strongly on growth of its AI platform.
Bought Israeli AI startup Inferize in a US$100-150 million deal.
Signed a 50MW data centre lease with AIB Data Centers.

worth_knowing.text: Has US$40 billion in customer commitments, but most of it comes from two customers.
Raised its prices for AI computing power by more than 20%.
A US city council restricted future data centres after local backlash against Nebius.
